{
 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-hermes-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference-3/play/users/u042/system/state/workspace/programs/task-30e55f0d.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The full-width/full-height lines are the panel separators.
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and grid[r][0] != 0]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h)) and grid[0][c] != 0]
    sep = grid[sep_rows[0]][0]
    row_starts = [0] + [r + 1 for r in sep_rows]
    row_ends = sep_rows + [h]
    col_starts = [0] + [c + 1 for c in sep_cols]
    col_ends = sep_cols + [w]

    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (0, sep))
    template_color = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    tr0 = tc0 = None
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == template_color:
                tr0, tc0 = r, c
                break
        if tr0 is not None:
            break
    # Template coordinates relative to its panel.
    ri = next(i for i, (a,b) in enumerate(zip(row_starts,row_ends)) if a <= tr0 < b)
    ci = next(i for i, (a,b) in enumerate(zip(col_starts,col_ends)) if a <= tc0 < b)
    template = [(r-row_starts[ri], c-col_starts[ci])
                for r in range(row_starts[ri],row_ends[ri])
                for c in range(col_starts[ci],col_ends[ci]) if grid[r][c] == template_color]

    out = [[sep if (r in sep_rows or c in sep_cols) else 0 for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
    # Each panel-row is keyed by the colored 2x2 marker in its first panel.
    for band, (ra, rb) in enumerate(zip(row_starts, row_ends)):
        source_colors = [grid[r][c] for r in range(ra,rb) for c in range(col_starts[0],col_ends[0])
                         if grid[r][c] not in (0, sep, template_color)]
        if not source_colors:
            continue
        color = Counter(source_colors).most_common(1)[0][0]
        for ca, cb in zip(col_starts, col_ends):
            for dr, dc in template:
                rr, cc = ra+dr, ca+dc
                if rr < rb and cc < cb:
                    out[rr][cc] = color
    return out
"
